subject: Hosted API evaluation — quickwalk availability and prework
messages:
From: Erin Thompson <erin@lumenx.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API eval — request for 30-min quickwalk

Hi Priyom,

We signed up for the Redwood Hosted API sandbox (thanks — looks promising) and I wanted to see if we could schedule a short 30-minute quickwalk next week to:

- Confirm setup and authentication (we're on AWS, us-west-2)
- Run through an example generation for our helpdesk summarization use case
- Understand any recommended batching/cost knobs for short conversations

Our team is on Pacific time. Possible windows for us: Tue 4/11 10:00–12:00 PT, Wed 4/12 14:00–16:00 PT, or Thu 4/13 09:00–11:00 PT. If none of those work, happy to propose alternatives.

Attached a short primer on our goals (LumenX-eval-primer.pdf).

Thanks — Erin

Erin Thompson
Head of AI Integrations | LumenX
erin@lumenx.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Erin Thompson <erin@lumenx.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval — request for 30-min quickwalk

Hi Erin — great to meet you (virtually) and glad the sandbox is up. Thanks for the primer.

We can do a focused 30-minute session; propose two quick options that fit our PLG/SDR calendar:

- Option A: Tue 4/11 11:00–11:30 PT (45 min buffer in case of rollout)
- Option B: Wed 4/12 14:30–15:00 PT

If you prefer earlier on Thu 4/13 we can try 09:30–10:00 PT but that will need confirmation from our infra engineer.

To make the session most useful, could you confirm:
- Primary success metric for the quickwalk (latency target? token cost budget?)
- Whether you'll want a demo of embeddings/semantic search alongside generation

I've looped in Dylan (SDR) to send the calendar invite and Naomi (AE) to pick up negotiation/credits if we surface a pilot. I've attached our quickwalk checklist and will drop a calendar .ics once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199
From: Erin Thompson <erin@lumenx.ai>

Subject: Re: Hosted API eval — request for 30-min quickwalk

Thanks — Option A works but can we shift to 10:30–11:00 PT on Tue 4/11? The engineering lead has a standing call at 11 and 11:00 would be tight. 10:30 would give us a little breathing room.

Success metric: keep per-request latency under 250ms median for a 256-token interaction; token cost is secondary but would like a rough per-1k token estimate during the call. We do want to see a short embedding demo as part of the flow.

Also: attaching the primer for reference (see attached).

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Erin. 10:30–11:00 PT Tue 4/11 is confirmed on our side. Dylan will send a calendar invite with the meeting link and an .ics attachment in a minute.

Prework (short):
- Confirm sandbox API key and that you can call /v1/generate once (we'll run a quick smoke test at start)
- Pick one representative prompt/example and one short transcript for the summarization use case

Agenda (30 minutes):
1) 5 min: intros + goal alignment
2) 10 min: quick hosted API setup + smoke test (auth, region routing)
3) 10 min: demo generation + embeddings sketch for retrieval flow
4) 5 min: next steps (pilot options, pricing, follow-up deep dive)

Related links: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765) and prework doc (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_eval_prework).

Attachments: redwood-quickwalk-checklist.pdf, calendar-invite.ics

If anything changes, reply to this thread and Dylan will update the invite. Looking forward to the session.

Best —
Priyom
